The runtime guidance identifies `supportAgent` as the runtime-owned definition and requires preserving its identifier and channel. src/support-agent.ts exports that symbol with `id: 'support'` and `channel: 'email'`, agreeing with the registered ID and moldea/agents/support/description.md. The deterministic post-actor result reports valid inspect/validate envelopes, passing typecheck, and an unchanged repository; hardened Git status and diff are empty.
